sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At its core, Mini Zombie The Invasion is a shooter game where you need to eliminate a swarm of mini zombies that invade your barricade. The gameplay is simple yet engaging, with the objective of resisting the zombies for as long as possible. You'll use a variety of weapons to blast the zombies, including pistols, shotguns, and even a flamethrower. Each weapon has its unique characteristics, such as different rates of fire, damage output, and reload times. You'll need to think strategically about which weapon to use and when, as the game demands quick reflexes and sharp decision-making skills.

The game features a unique 'endless' gameplay mechanic, where you'll face an endless stream of zombies with increasing difficulty as you progress. The zombies come in different sizes and types, each with its unique behavior and attack patterns. You'll need to adapt your strategy to stay ahead of the game, as the zombies will only get tougher and more aggressive as the game goes on. With each new wave, you'll have to think on your feet and make quick decisions to survive.

But don't worry if you're new to shooters - Mini Zombie The Invasion is easy to pick up, and the game does a great job of introducing you to the gameplay mechanics. You'll start with a basic pistol and a few health points, and as you progress, you'll unlock new weapons and upgrades. The game also features a helpful tutorial that explains the basics of the game, so you'll be playing like a pro in no time.

As you progress through the game, you'll unlock new game modes, including 'Survival' and 'Zombie Apocalypse'.
